imagens.tema: Dia dos Animais: o que avaliar antes de adotar
imagens.estilo: Teatro de papel esculpido, luz de pátio e primeiro encontro
imagens.prompt: Create one original finished 4:5 raster editorial artwork for the Brazilian Saúde Pet blog. Photograph a beautifully crafted miniature PAPER THEATRE about considering adoption carefully. An airy Mediterranean-Brazilian courtyard is built from thick ivory cotton paper, with a single tall ochre arch, a pale terracotta floor and sharply visible cut edges. Warm late-afternoon sunlight makes the architecture glow through thin paper and casts one diagonal leafy shadow. In the lower half, an older man in a cream shirt and blue trousers sits sideways on a simple bench, hands resting loosely on his knees. An adult brindle mixed-breed dog with one gently folded ear approaches him at its own pace, leaving a meaningful open interval between them. Both figures are complete, delicately painted three-dimensional paper sculptures with convincing anatomy, not flat clip art. On the bench at the far side of the man lie just a small closed coin purse and an open pocket diary with completely blank pages: quiet references to resources and time, never a shopping transaction. One bench slat is Saúde Pet teal #159fa3; one small diary tab is orange #f58235. Compose with fine-art restraint, tactile fibers, warm luminous whites and deep clean shadows. The emotional center is a patient first encounter, not a forced hug or tragic rescue. No cage, scattered icons, text, fake logos, price tags, costumes or extra ornaments. No lilac walls or decorative paw motifs. Keep the dog, man and brand accents comfortably inside the frame.
imagens.alt_planejado: Teatro de papel mostra homem sentado em banco turquesa e cachorro tigrado que se aproxima com calma, sob arco claro e luz dourada; agenda e porta-moedas repousam no banco.
imagens.motivo: Transforma a adoção em um encontro delicado com espaço para escolha. O vazio entre tutor e animal, a luz sobre o papel e os dois objetos discretos comunicam vínculo, tempo e recursos sem virar infográfico.

imagens.tema: Exames de rotina depois dos sete anos: quais e de quanto em quanto tempo
imagens.estilo: Retrato fotográfico em prata, focinho grisalho e luz de janela
imagens.prompt: Create one original finished 4:5 raster editorial artwork for the Brazilian Saúde Pet blog. Make an exceptional large-format SILVER-GELATIN style black-and-white photograph of a senior black Labrador, dignified and fully alive, framed from upper chest to just above the complete ears at the dog's eye level. The gray muzzle is richly detailed, individual silver hairs dissolving softly into deep black fur; luminous eyes look slightly toward the photographer. Mouth relaxed and closed. A large window outside frame provides tender broad side light, a fine eye catchlight and a gradual shadow transition across the face. Background is plain charcoal with nuanced photographic grain, not a room filled with props. The lower foreground contains the corner of a real translucent vellum planning sheet, lying on a low surface in front of the dog and never crossing its muzzle or eyes. Only a small EMPTY calendar grid is visible; no words, dates, age numerals, medical results or prescribed frequency. An elegant tiny paper clip in Saúde Pet orange #f58235 holds the sheet and is the ONLY color in the image. Sharp focus on eyes and silver muzzle, vellum softly readable, sumptuous tonal depth without over-sharpening or a harsh vignette. The expression conveys companionship and continued attentive care, not sadness or a farewell portrait. No halo, pills, examination equipment, decorative paws, logos, text or diagnosis. Leave natural breathing space around ears and face.
imagens.alt_planejado: Fotografia em preto e branco de labrador idoso com focinho grisalho e olhar atento, iluminado de lado; um calendário vazio com pequeno clipe laranja aparece no primeiro plano.
imagens.motivo: Concentra a força visual nos olhos e nos pelos grisalhos, com qualidade de retrato de galeria. O planejamento aparece de maneira discreta, sem impor frequência clínica ou transformar envelhecimento em tristeza.

imagens.tema: Novembro Azul pet: próstata em cães machos
imagens.estilo: Azulejaria autoral em cobalto, conversa e cuidado
imagens.prompt: Create one original finished 3:2 raster editorial artwork for the Brazilian Saúde Pet blog. A photographed HAND-PAINTED CERAMIC TILE MURAL, visually as refined as an intimate architectural art commission. Compose one continuous scene across a small field of warm ivory square tiles: at left an adult Black woman with short natural hair, wearing a simple cream blouse and dark blue trousers, sits at equal eye level opposite an older male veterinarian on the right. Their restrained hand gestures show an attentive conversation. A calm adult brown male dog stands naturally between them, slightly forward, all four paws correctly placed and anatomically plausible. No examination or anatomy is shown. The entire illustration is made with fluid cobalt and indigo brushwork that pools beautifully under a transparent glaze, with convincing tiny crazing, modest tile seams and raking daylight. The people and dog must read clearly as a tender coherent scene, not isolated tile icons. Spare pale background; just two simple chairs and a closed notebook on the owner's lap. The notebook has Saúde Pet teal #159fa3 glaze on its cover and a small blue awareness-ribbon motif. A tiny orange #f58235 ceramic dash near its spine supplies a quiet second brand accent. Modern elegant drawing, porcelain white breathing room, a few dense blue shapes, warm human expressions. No extra vase, paws, lettering, improvised logo, stereotypical masculinity, medical promise, procedure, syringe or prescription. Use richly crafted materials and clean composition rather than decorative overload.
imagens.alt_planejado: Painel de azulejos pintados em azul cobalto mostra tutora e veterinário conversando com um cachorro adulto entre eles; o caderno turquesa tem um pequeno laço azul.
imagens.motivo: Dá ao Novembro Azul uma presença artística própria pela azulejaria, com azul temático e verde da marca integrados. A conversa entre pessoas e o cão substitui símbolos genéricos de campanha.

imagens.tema: Rotina de um pet com doença crônica sem virar um segundo emprego
imagens.estilo: Fotografia de rotina em varanda, linho e sombras de veneziana
imagens.prompt: Create one original finished 4:3 raster editorial artwork for the Brazilian Saúde Pet blog. An exquisitely observed but believable lifestyle STILL-LIFE PHOTOGRAPH about making ongoing pet care part of an ordinary day. Set it in a quiet covered Brazilian veranda with a rough pale sand wall, old honey-colored wood, an olive-green shutter outside frame and wide sunlit stripes falling diagonally across the table. Use an intimate oblique viewpoint: the left foreground holds a small open cloth-bound weekly planner with completely blank pages and only a few EMPTY checkbox outlines; beside it, one CLOSED unbranded care pouch and a loosely coiled walking leash. A glass of water sits farther back, no medicine or food. The planner's Saúde Pet teal #159fa3 cover is partly visible and has the exact small words 'Saúde Pet' debossed in dark ink, without any emblem. On the right, beyond the table, a small older white rough-coated terrier rests comfortably in a low washable bed near its owner's bare lower legs and simple sandals. Include only the person's lower legs, not a posed face; the dog is part of the room, never a prop. Soft cream linen, honest wood marks, fur detail, a thin orange #f58235 stitch on the leash. Make negative space, angled light and careful depth the visual pleasure. No purple room, decorative plant collection, floating checklist, doses, claims, extra text, fake logos, hospital equipment or overflowing schedule. The scene should feel spacious, possible and affectionate.
imagens.alt_planejado: Luz de veneziana atravessa mesa de madeira com agenda Saúde Pet turquesa, estojo fechado e guia; ao lado, terrier idoso branco descansa perto das pernas do tutor.
imagens.motivo: A rotina ganha beleza pela luz, pelos materiais naturais e pelo espaço livre. A varanda e o enquadramento parcial da presença humana variam os cenários sem perder o vínculo entre organização e convivência.

imagens.tema: Ceia de Natal: os alimentos que mandam pet para a emergência
imagens.estilo: Panorama natalino em guache e pastel, luz de verão
imagens.prompt: Create one original finished 16:9 raster editorial artwork for the Brazilian Saúde Pet blog. Paint a luminous and sophisticated Brazilian CHRISTMAS-EVE PANORAMA in opaque gouache with delicate oil-pastel highlights on visibly textured paper. Think beautifully illustrated contemporary picture book for adults, with graceful architecture and cinematic color. Foreground: a covered sitting area with warm red clay tiles, where a middle-aged man in an ivory linen shirt sits relaxed in a broad woven chair. A black-and-white cat curls comfortably beside him on the chair; a shaggy gray dog lies nearby on a plain deep-green rug, with its own water bowl in Saúde Pet teal #159fa3. The man gives them quiet company. Behind them, a LARGE FIRMLY CLOSED GLAZED DOUBLE DOOR separates this area from the family Christmas dinner. Only a few warm silhouettes and an elevated dinner table are visible through the glass; ALL human food stays behind the closed door, inaccessible to the pets. The glass reflects tiny gold fairy lights. A single restrained garland is mounted high over the door, safely out of reach, with one Saúde Pet orange #f58235 ribbon. Palette of deep malachite, raspberry red, warm cream, midnight blue and amber light; no snow, no lilac. Use wide calm horizontal rhythms and richly painted pools of light, not a busy food display. No scraps, feeding, dangling tinsel, candles near pets, costumes, warning icons, fake logo or text. The emotional center is a beautiful Christmas shared through safe companionship.
imagens.alt_planejado: Natal em guache mostra homem, gato preto e branco e cachorro cinza em área acolhedora, separados da ceia por porta de vidro fechada; luzes douradas, tigela turquesa e laço laranja completam a cena.
imagens.motivo: Traz um Natal brasileiro de verão, com profundidade, reflexos e convivência afetuosa. A comida fica claramente inacessível, e a narrativa de cuidado continua legível sem cartaz de alerta.

imagens.tema: Réveillon e fogos: o plano completo, hora a hora
imagens.estilo: Livro sanfonado em papel, do dourado da tarde ao azul da noite
imagens.prompt: Create one original finished 16:9 raster editorial artwork for the Brazilian Saúde Pet blog. Photograph an exceptionally beautiful HANDMADE ACCORDION PICTURE BOOK opened to THREE connected upright illustrated panels on pale oak, viewed slightly above and from the front so the paper folds, thickness and cast shadows are exquisite. Each panel is a complete enclosed home interior at a different moment of New Year's Eve. Use the SAME adult dark-skinned man in a plain ivory shirt and the SAME short-legged black-and-tan dog, consistently marked and realistically proportioned, appearing once per panel. First panel, honey-colored late afternoon: the owner prepares an open cozy floor den while the dog watches nearby. Second panel, deep clear blue hour: the pair sit quietly near that den, behind drawn curtains. Third panel, dark midnight blue with a low amber lamp: the dog rests comfortably and the owner sits nearby. All exterior windows and doors are firmly CLOSED; page folds are clearly book divisions, never open gaps to outdoors. In the third panel only, a tiny distant gold firework may be visible through one closed high window, far from the pet. Paint every scene by hand in gouache with warm expressive faces and finely layered paper details. The same den is Saúde Pet teal #159fa3 with a little orange #f58235 fabric tab. Restrained amber-to-blue progression, tiny highlights and abundant quiet areas; no violet domestic template. No clock times, numbers, prescriptions, sedation, guarantees, labels, logos or extra text. The book should feel like a treasured art object and the sequence should read as calm preparation and presence.
imagens.alt_planejado: Livro sanfonado artesanal reúne três momentos do mesmo tutor e cachorro no Réveillon, do preparo do refúgio turquesa ao descanso à noite, em ambientes fechados.
imagens.motivo: A passagem do tempo acontece pela mudança de luz entre as páginas. O livro físico cria textura e profundidade, preservando a sequência do tema sem inventar horários ou orientações clínicas.

imagens.tema: A revisão anual do seu pet: o retrospecto de doze meses
imagens.estilo: Álbum em papel de algodão, fotografias e sol de fim de tarde
imagens.prompt: Create one original finished 4:3 raster editorial artwork for the Brazilian Saúde Pet blog. An intimate overhead ART-BOOK PHOTOGRAPH of an open handmade pet album on a simple warm cream linen surface. The album is the clear hero, filling most of the frame with lovely deckled cotton-paper pages, precise linen stitching, real page thickness and restrained asymmetric composition. Arrange FOUR small matte photographic prints across the spread, held by plain paper corners. All four show the SAME adult black-and-white mixed-breed dog, recognizably consistent with one black left-eye patch and white muzzle: settling beside its owner at home, an ordinary leashed park walk, a calm veterinary conversation with the owner beside it, and resting in its familiar floor bed. It remains the same adult dog throughout the year, no artificial age transformation or duplicated limbs. Ordinary affectionate memories, not treatment success claims. A folded care record with entirely blank pages is partially tucked behind the final photo. No charts, test values, awards or certificates. The real Saúde Pet teal #159fa3 cloth cover peeks around the page edges; a slim orange #f58235 ribbon bookmark flows once across a generous empty area without covering photographs. The only lettering is the elegant small handwritten Portuguese title 'Nosso ano' at the upper left. Late afternoon sunlight grazes the paper from one side, bringing warm shadows, delicate grain and a feeling of holding a year's memories. No extra stickers, scattered leaves, paw motifs, fake logos, props, text or ornamental clutter. Exact legible title and beautifully distinct photographs are essential.
imagens.alt_planejado: Álbum artesanal com título Nosso ano reúne quatro fotografias do mesmo cachorro preto e branco em momentos de casa, passeio e consulta; capa turquesa e fita laranja aparecem entre páginas de papel texturizado.
imagens.motivo: Encerra o calendário com intimidade e acabamento de livro de arte. A identidade consistente do cão e a seleção de momentos comuns dão sentido à retrospectiva, sem inventar resultados de saúde.
